subject: Starship V3 ship geometry relevant to aerodynamics and the catch, from a community photogrammetry compendium
source: spacecraft-models/starship, dimensions.md (GitHub). Measurements scaled from NASASpaceflight photos of Ship 39 and others, each labelled Published, Reported or Estimated with its error. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (model, scripts and analysis; reference images excluded). Facts are recorded here with attribution.
confidence: estimate (photogrammetry) unless an entry says reported or published
reference_frame: z in metres up from the bottom edge of the aft skirt (z = 0) to the nose tip (z = 52.1 m); azimuth 0 deg = windward (tiled) centreline, 180 deg = leeward

height_m.check: 51.7 +/- 1.7 m measured in a stack photo

forward_flaps.status: estimate (Starfactory photo), +/-0.6 m and +/-5 deg unless noted
forward_flaps.edges: trailing edge drops about 1 m from the hinge bottom to the tip bottom; leading edge strongly swept, dropping about 4 m from the hinge top to the tip top
forward_flaps.flap_plane: each plane turned about 14 deg from radial toward leeward, so the planes are about 136 deg apart (reported: about 140 deg, since V2)
forward_flaps.construction: one thickness throughout, rounded edges, three hinges with a single control arm at the central one (reported, Ringwatchers V2; V3 externally similar)
forward_flaps.relation_to_catch_pins: lowest corners about 2.5 m above the catch pins

span_tip_to_tip_m.status: reported (Wikipedia), not tied to a version

actuation.value: one actuator with three motors per flap on V3 (two actuators on V2)

aft_flaps.hinge_fairings: static aero strip 0.6-0.8 m wide along the root; tiled leading-edge cap about 0.8 m wide, tip 1.5-1.7 m above the flap root

catch_pins.note: two wedge-shaped tiled fairings on the nosecone; reported (NSF) as the main lifting point on V3

rcs.v3: redesigned: roll thrusters on the payload bay in two opposed pairs, another set about midway down, and outlets fed through the aft flap hinges onto a gas-steering plate
rcs.v1_v2: cold-gas thrusters on ullage gas: four below the payload bay and two on the LOX tank

model_comparison.model_stack_length_m: 54.0 (engines 4.5 + tank 30.5 + command 19.0), versus 52.1 published from skirt edge to tip
model_comparison.model_forward_flap: hinge parallel to the axis at 90/270 deg, centre about 1.75 m below the nose base on the barrel, 5.7 x 2.55 m rectangle
model_comparison.measured_forward_flap: on the ogive with its centre about 7.6 m above the nose base, hinge tilted about 19 deg at about 98/262 deg, plane turned 14 deg leeward, swept trapezoid of about 14 m2
model_comparison.consequence: the model's forward flaps sit about 9 m too far aft, which shortens their pitch moment arm, and their parallel-to-axis hinge leaves the heading moment second order
